snippet.title: Project ZETA | gamescom Opening Night Live (ONL) 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Project ZETA hits gamescom Opening Night Live (ONL) 2026.

Watch the new trailer and get your latest look at Project ZETA.
Then request access on Steam for the Sept 4-6 playtest

Four teams enter the Aran Plateau. One Prism. Move fast, strike first, and secure the Prism before anyone else does.
